name: Backgammon
tagline: Fifteen checkers, two dice, a wooden table. Play the computer, or a friend on the other side.
description:
A table of twenty-four points. White and black take turns rolling two dice and moving their fifteen checkers toward home. Hit a blot, send it to the bar. Bear them all off and you win. Doubles are played four times. There is no doubling cube.

On your own you play a computer that thinks on this device. There is no game server. Pass the phone for two people in the same room, or press Play a friend and send the invite: the same table, live, on two devices. White sits one side, black the other. White goes first. Roll, tap a point to move with the highlighted die, confirm the turn.

An unofficial port of backgammonjs by quasoft. The rules are the same general table that shipped with that game.
